newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks charge to unofficial closing record.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks charge to unofficial closing record.

text.p: Mexican stocks extended earlier gains Friday to chalk up an unofficial closing record for the third time this week.
Traders and analysts said local and foreign dealers bought on cue from sharp gains on Wall Street, and on foreign fund flows and continuing technical factors.
Preliminary figures placed the leading IPC share index .MXX up 41.32 points, or 1.00 percent, at 4,160.85.
Meanwhile in New York, the Dow Jones Industrial Average lurched higher to close up 130 points at 7,435.
